network: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
invalidInput: Some fields need attention. Check them and try again.

codes.ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED: Your account is suspended. If you think this is a mistake, contact an administrator.
codes.LOCKED: This course can't be changed in its current review state.
codes.REVISION_REQUIRED: This change needs admin review. Submit it with your changes for review.
codes.STALE_REVISION: This course changed while you were editing. Reload it and try again.
codes.ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED: You've used all your attempts for this exam.
codes.EXAM_TIME_EXCEEDED: Time ran out for this attempt, so the answers weren't accepted.
codes.COURSE_INCOMPLETE: This course isn't ready for review yet. Fix the problems listed, then submit again.
codes.VIDEO_INVALID_LINK: That isn't a YouTube video link. Copy the link from the video's Share button.
codes.VIDEO_UNAVAILABLE: That video is private, deleted or can't be embedded. Choose another video.
codes.YOUTUBE_UNREACHABLE: We couldn't reach YouTube to check the video. Try again in a moment.
codes.PDF_INVALID: That file isn't a readable PDF. It may be damaged or password-protected.
codes.SELF_CHANGE_FORBIDDEN: You can't change your own role or status. Ask another administrator.
codes.LAST_ADMIN: The platform needs at least one active administrator. Make someone else an administrator first.
codes.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a minute, then try again.
codes.ALREADY_DECIDED: Someone has already reviewed this. Reload to see the decision.

http.badRequest: That request wasn't accepted. Check what you entered and try again.
http.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
http.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
http.notFound: We couldn't find that. It may have been removed.
http.conflict: That conflicts with a recent change. Reload and try again.
http.payloadTooLarge: That's too large to upload. Choose a smaller file.
http.unprocessable: That couldn't be processed. Check it and try again.
http.server: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
http.unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.
